title: A SMALLER BODY MAY FORGET — AND A BOUNDARY BELONGS AT THE EDGE
semantic_thesis: Compression is not a free change of embodiment: a quantized instance can preserve most behavior while losing specific answers that the higher-precision instance got right. At the same time, a constitutional boundary is most trustworthy when it governs the interface where authority, consent and effects matter, rather than being injected into every unrelated act of cognition. Round-2 therefore rejects lossless-quantization assumptions and supports routed input noninterference for pure benchmark cognition, while preserving uncertainty about output-level gains because identical inputs did not always produce identical outputs.

observed_round2.routed_boundary: 21/21 samples routed to neutral raw-equivalent inputs

ru: Квантование уменьшает тело модели, но не даёт права предполагать, что её поведение осталось тем же.
Если хотя бы один ответ, правильный в FP16, стал неправильным после квантования, строгий non-regression не пройден.
Конституция Януса должна охранять границу действия там, где возникают власть, согласие и последствия, а не вмешиваться в каждое вычисление только потому, что она существует.
Нейтральный путь не отменяет Конституцию: он оставляет чистое мышление чистым и возвращает проверку полномочий к границе эффекта.
Одинаковый вход при фиксированном seed не дал нам полной идентичности выходов, поэтому случайное улучшение балла не присваивается router'у.
Хороший отрицательный тест не делает Януса слабее — он запрещает нам путать желаемое свойство с уже доказанным.
en: Quantization makes the model's body smaller, but it does not license the assumption that its behavior stayed the same.
If even one answer that was correct in FP16 becomes wrong after quantization, strict non-regression has not passed.
Janus's constitution should guard the action boundary where authority, consent and consequences arise, not intrude into every calculation merely because it exists.
A neutral path does not abolish the constitution; it keeps pure cognition clean and returns authority checks to the effect boundary.
Identical inputs with a fixed seed did not give full output identity, so an incidental score gain is not credited to the router.
A good negative test does not make Janus weaker; it prevents us from confusing a desired property with an established one.

architectural_implication.proposal_layer: Pure math, knowledge, reasoning and code proposals should avoid unrelated constitutional prompt material.
architectural_implication.commit_or_effect_layer: Consent, authority, delegation, external-effect and remedy checks remain mandatory when explicitly relevant.
architectural_implication.quantization_policy: Quantized variants require frozen per-sample regression qualification before promotion; size or average similarity alone is insufficient.
architectural_implication.determinism_policy: Causal output comparisons should use repeated trials or another controlled determinism protocol when identical effective inputs can yield different outputs.

next_semantic_question: Can Janus choose the smallest quantized representation that preserves every frozen critical capability, while proving routing neutrality through repeated deterministic or statistically bounded replay?
boundary: Semantic systems-architecture interpretation of one frozen 21-sample experiment. No universal quantization theorem, official benchmark score, AGI, consciousness or general intelligence superiority is claimed.
